tourism_demand.reason: Annual India arrivals support a small historical baseline; no current or destination-level coverage.

data.geography: India national total; not Uttarakhand or individual destinations
data.units: international tourist arrivals per calendar year; annual dates have no time zone
data.imputation: none; trailing null targets excluded, internal gaps rejected

tourism_demand.alignment: Single national annual series; never join local weather to national totals.
tourism_demand.leakage: Use strictly prior annual lags; chronological train/validation/test; source vintage backtest only.

disaster_risk.task: future documented flood event by region/time (proposed, no trained target)
disaster_risk.reason: UNDRR HIPs are hazard definitions, not observed events. No event dates, region outcomes, verified negative windows or impact labels.

data.temporal_coverage: publication timestamps only; no event history

disaster_risk.alignment: Need region boundaries, event occurrence/completeness windows and features available before cutoff.
disaster_risk.leakage: Group shared events; future weather/reanalysis is unavailable at forecast cutoff.

flood_segmentation.reason: Sentinel scenes and quality/cloud masks exist; no verified paired observed flood masks or event-separated labelled splits.

data.alignment: No paired flood masks to validate; SCL/cloud/quality masks are not flood labels.
data.split: Require event/scene/geography split before overlapping patches.
data.georeferencing: GeoTIFF header tags inspected where readable; full CRS/transform validation requires rasterio.

flood_segmentation.alignment: Require matching CRS, transform, footprint, acquisition and binary mask classes.
flood_segmentation.leakage: Split events/geographies before patch extraction; never threshold imagery into claimed ground truth.

destination_stress.task: observed capacity utilization/crowding prediction (requires target definition)
destination_stress.reason: No observed stress, occupancy, crowd-density or aligned capacity time series. National arrivals and static OSM POIs do not establish destination stress.

data.geography: unaligned national series and regional snapshot

destination_stress.alignment: Need common destination/time IDs, observed utilization units, capacities and pre-cutoff features.
destination_stress.leakage: Future visitor totals cannot be prediction-time features. Arbitrary weighted scores are not labels.
